About.title: About
About.intro: From renting a place at 15 to being Brazil's #1 trader - the full journey behind Ai X PULSE RS.
story: My name is Alesson Felipe, 36 years old today. I've always been a simple person with big dreams. At 15, I was already renting a place with my wife, who was 16 at the time - just a bed, a mattress, a stove, and a gas canister. I spent seven years working at a beverage warehouse that supplied the beach vendors of Boa Viagem, in Recife. I used to watch the buildings along the shore and the cars driving down the seafront, picturing myself one day moving out of that rental, with a decent car to take my family out in.

It was at that warehouse that I bought my first PC, paying it off little by little. I taught myself computing, downloading guides from the internet - formatting computers, installing Windows, then slideshow discs and CD compilations. I left the warehouse job, went to work as a waiter's assistant, and kept dreaming: one day I'd give my family what I saw successful people doing every day.

I started studying how to make money online - affiliate systems, dropshipping. Affiliates didn't work out, but dropshipping did: I sold my first R$10,000, R$15,000 importing from China. When marketplaces started banning dropshippers in Brazil, I learned to code and built my own online store. Traffic was the problem, so I went after marketing, automated posting in Facebook groups, and ended up with over 100 recurring customers in an affiliate system I built myself - until that also ran into account bans.

At the end of 2015 I discovered binary options. I lost a lot of money at first. I studied it in depth - probability, tops and bottoms, uptrend/downtrend lines, pullbacks - until I became the #1 trader in Brazil and Top 5 in the world on IQ Option, in 2019.

The binary options accounts eventually got banned too, and that's how I ended up in forex. I tried applying the same strategy - it didn't work, so I went back to studying from scratch, this time focused on market structure and automated strategy. Between 2022 and 2023 I lost money chasing miracle robots, buying HFT EAs that promised to turn a little into a lot overnight. I fell for scams more than once.

So I decided to develop my own EA - a hybrid HFT/scalper model, since serious brokers don't allow pure HFT. That's when profit started becoming consistent. And that's also when I learned the most important lesson: without a target and without compound interest, an account blows up. Today, Ai X PULSE RS is that lesson applied - a realistic daily target, aiming for a high return over the long term through compound interest, not the empty promise of getting rich overnight.

I'm still married to my wife after more than 21 years - she's been through every high and low of this journey with me - and today I'm a father of three. I'm a Christian, and it was my faith that kept me steady through the hardest periods.
If you've ever fallen for a scam, tried everything and gotten frustrated, or just want to see your money actually working for you - that's exactly why Ai X PULSE RS exists.

technical.heading: How It Works Under the Hood

steps.title: Entry Strategy
steps.body: Continuously monitors the market and positions orders strategically around price. When gold breaks out with strength in one direction, the robot enters in favor of that move, with entry distance that adapts automatically to current market conditions.

steps.title: Volatility Filter
steps.body: Only opens trades when it detects real market expansion - staying out during sideways, directionless periods, which is exactly where most robots lose money to unnecessary costs.

steps.title: Position Management
steps.body: Tracks each trade and adjusts protection as profit builds, reacting quickly to price changes to preserve accumulated gains.

steps.title: Trend-Following
steps.body: Once a direction is identified, the robot trades only in favor of the trend - and automatically resolves conflicting positions if the market spikes both ways at once.

steps.title: Goals & Auto-Pause
steps.body: Tracks cumulative results per day, week, and month (in value or percentage). Once the target is hit, it closes everything and pauses until the next period.

steps.title: Configurable Risk Management
steps.body: Three lot-sizing modes: fixed lot, balance-based lot (scales with account size), or percentage risk calculated on account balance.

steps.title: Broker Overload Protection
steps.body: Internal safeguards prevent excessive requests to the broker - a common technical issue that triggers alerts and blocks - keeping operation stable even on stricter brokers.

steps.title: Time & Spread Filter
steps.body: Only trades within the configured time window (down to the minute) and respects a maximum spread ceiling.

steps.title: Visual Control Panel
steps.body: On-chart interface showing balance, equity, floating profit, results by period, open/pending trades, session status, and manual control buttons.

risk.body: Ai X PULSE RS is an automated trading tool. Like any operation in financial markets, it involves risk, and past results don't guarantee future ones. We strongly recommend testing on a demo account before trading real capital, and always using risk management suited to your profile.

guide.title: MT4 installation guide
guide.intro: Follow the steps in order. It takes about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Download the robot
steps.body: On the Downloads page, click Download on the Current version and save the .ex4 file on the computer or VPS where MT4 will run.

steps.title: Put the file in MT4
steps.body: In MT4, go to File > Open Data Folder and open MQL4 > Experts. Paste the .ex4 file there. Then close and reopen MT4: the robot shows up in the Navigator, under Expert Advisors.

steps.title: Allow the license server
steps.body: Go to Tools > Options > Expert Advisors tab. Check "Allow automated trading" and "Allow WebRequest for listed URL", add the address below and click OK. Without this the robot can't check your license.

steps.title: Check your MT4 accounts
steps.body: On the Licenses page you'll find the accounts you entered at checkout. If you left a slot empty, fill it in and click Save accounts. The Monthly License allows up to 2 accounts and the Lifetime up to 5.

steps.title: Open the gold chart on M5
steps.body: Open the XAUUSD chart on the M5 timeframe. Some brokers use another name for gold, like XAUUSDm (Exness Standard) or XAUUSD.r. Use the name shown in your Market Watch.

steps.title: Attach the robot to the chart
steps.body: Drag Ai X PULSE RS from the Navigator onto the chart. On the Common tab, check "Allow live trading" and click OK. Make sure the AutoTrading button on the top bar is on.

steps.title: Accept the terms
steps.body: The first time on each account, a window with the terms of use appears. Click OK. It won't show again on that account, not even when MT4 or the VPS restarts.

steps.title: Check the panel
steps.body: The license status shows at the bottom of the robot's panel. If everything is fine, it shows the license type (and the expiry date, for monthly). Within a few minutes the account shows as Active on the MT4 Accounts page, here in the portal. Below is what each message means.

statuses.meaning: Monthly license active, with its expiry date. All good.
The robot hasn't checked the license yet. It shows right after opening MT4 or while the market is closed, and goes away with the first price move.
This MT4 account isn't registered on any license. Add the number on the Licenses page. The robot unlocks by itself within 5 minutes.
The license expired. Renew it here in the portal: once the payment is confirmed, the robot unlocks by itself within 5 minutes.
The license was blocked. Contact support.
Step 3 is missing: allow the license server address in MT4.
The robot couldn't reach the license server (internet or server down). It tries again every 5 minutes.
No connection right now, but the license was confirmed recently. The robot keeps trading for up to 48 hours while the connection comes back.
More than 48 hours without checking the license. Check your internet and step 3.

tips: To trade 24 hours a day, use a VPS: the robot only works while MT4 is open.
Use an account with a gold spread of up to 30 points.
If the license expires, the robot stays on the chart but stops trading, including managing open orders. It comes back by itself when the license is active again, so renew before it expires.
Need to change an MT4 account? You can change it once on the Licenses page. After that, message me on Telegram.
To see full week and month results on MT4 Accounts, set the Account History tab in MT4 to "All History" (right-click inside the tab).

robot.title: Configure robot - account {login}
robot.intro: Set the robot your way: each pair with its own parameters, plus account limits. The robot applies changes on its own within 30 seconds (version v6.8 or newer).
robot.symbolsHint: Keep the robot on the gold chart (XAUUSD). Turn on the pairs it should trade from that chart.
robot.clickPair: Click a pair's name to adjust only that pair. Defaults are the developer's parameters.
robot.maxSymbols: Up to {n} pairs on at the same time.
robot.pipInfo: 1 pip on this asset = {pip}. If unsure, keep the distances on Automatic.
robot.brokerCount: {n} assets at {broker} · Forex, Metals, Crypto, Indices...
robot.brokerNone: Update the robot to v7.1 to see your broker's assets
robot.brokerNoneHint: Robot v7.1 reads your broker's asset list (Forex, Metals, Crypto, Indices, Energy, Stocks...) and sends it here. Download v7.1 in Downloads, replace it on the chart and come back in 1 minute.
robot.brokerMore: Showing {n} of {total}. Use search to find the asset.
robot.brokerUpdated: List read from the broker on {date}.
robot.brokerRefreshSent: Request sent. The robot sends the list within 1 minute (reload the page).
robot.brokerHint: Turned on a new asset? Click it in the list above to adjust it. On indices, crypto and stocks, keep distances on Automatic (the robot adjusts to volatility) until you test it in a backtest or candle reading.
robot.riskHint: How much of the balance the robot risks on each entry in this pair (up to the loss close).
robot.pairLoss: Daily loss limit for this pair
robot.pairGoalHint: When hit, only this pair stops until the next day. The other pairs keep going.
robot.recoveryHint: After a loss, the next entry slightly increases the lot to recover.
robot.rsiZoneHint: 50-50 enters more often. Wider zones (30-70, 20-80...) only enter at extremes.
robot.atrHint: Only enters when volatility is in the normal range.
robot.adxHint: In a strong trend, trades with it.
robot.zonesHint: Uses the highs and lows of the chosen timeframes.
robot.breakEvenHint: After some profit, protects the entry so it doesn't turn into a loss.
robot.trailingHint: Follows the price and locks in profit as it moves.
robot.adxRising: Only count a trend while the ADX is rising
robot.zoneLines: Show the lines on the chart
robot.zoneLinesHint: Lines only appear on the chart the robot is attached to.
robot.zoneCandlesHint: High and low = highest high and lowest low of the last closed candles of each timeframe. From {min} to {max}.
robot.pipsHint: From {min} to {max} pips. Automatic = {auto} pips on gold; on other pairs it follows volatility.
robot.exitsHint: Values in pips of the pair (on gold 1 pip = 0.01). Automatic = the robot's usual values.
robot.lossCloseHint: When off, the position only has the emergency stop at the broker (3x the limit).
robot.lossPipsHint: From {min} to {max} pips. The lot size is based on it (your % risk). Automatic = {auto} pips on gold; at least 10 pips on pairs.
robot.beTrigger: Turns on at a profit of
robot.copyAll: Copy these settings to all pairs
robot.copied: {pair} settings copied to all pairs. Click Save.
robot.ddHint: If open trades lose this % of the balance, the robot closes everything and pauses until the next day. Up to {cap}%.
robot.goalHint: When hit, the robot closes everything and stops until the next day. Counts all pairs combined.
robot.newsHint: Pauses before and after high-impact news.
robot.saved: Saved. The robot applies it within 30 seconds.
robot.adminNote: You are an admin: you see and choose everything here. The limits in Admin → Settings → Robot don't apply to accounts saved by an admin.
robot.backtestHint: The MT4 Strategy Tester has no internet access, so the robot (v6.9 or newer) uses the settings saved on the computer.
robot.backtestAuto: If the robot already runs on this computer with this account, you don't need to do anything: it saves the site settings by itself and the backtest uses the same ones.
robot.backtestManual: On another computer: download the file below and put it in the MT4 Common\Files folder (in MT4: File → Open Data Folder, go up one folder and open Common → Files).
robot.backtestPair: The MT4 tester tests one pair at a time: pick the pair there (gold, EUR/USD...) and the robot uses that pair's settings from this site. The report shows "BACKTEST - PORTAL SETTINGS".
robot.backtestSaveFirst: Save before downloading: the file carries the saved settings.
